name: moqt-js
description: MOQT (Media over QUIC Transport) client library for browsers
author: Shiguredo Inc.

scripts.build:shaka: node shaka-player/scripts/vendor-shaka.mjs && vp build shaka-player && node scripts/assemble-shaka-player.mjs
scripts.build:web: vp run build:devtools && vp run build:shaka
scripts.e2e-test: vp run build && vp exec playwright test --project='chromium'
scripts.e2e-test:production: vp run build && vp exec playwright test --project='chromium-production'
scripts.e2e-test:relay: vp run build && vp exec playwright test --project='relay' --project='chromium-production-relay'
